title: Matterbridge Ecovacs Plugin
description: Expose Ecovacs robot vacuums (Deebot, yeedi) as Matter RVC devices

country.title: Country Code
country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code of your Ecovacs account, e.g. us, de, gb

continent.title: Continent
continent.description: Ecovacs continent code: na, eu, or as

deviceId.title: Ecovacs Device ID (advanced)
deviceId.description: Leave empty to generate one automatically. Ecovacs ties its one-time email device verification to this ID, so set it explicitly to reuse an already-verified ID — e.g. one verified from another machine with 'npx matterbridge-ecovacs-verify --device-id'.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.
